parsed.draft_response:
Hi—I'm sorry this is happening again. I understand you’re seeing the app as fully non-functional and need this addressed urgently.

To help Engineering investigate right away, could you reply with the minimum details below?
1) What product/app is affected (name and version, if known)?
2) What exactly “doesn’t work anymore” (which feature/workflow)?
3) When did it start (and is it continuous or intermittent)?
4) Any error message text (or a screenshot) you see when it fails.
5) Where you’re using it (web/iOS/Android, and region if relevant).

If you still can’t access the app, please confirm whether the same failure happens for other users in your team (all users vs only your accounts). Once we have this, we’ll escalate to the engineering team to diagnose and work toward a resolution.
promised_actions: Escalate the report to the engineering team for investigation once we receive the requested details
Request the minimum necessary information to identify the affected area, scope, and symptoms
safety_notes: Do not claim an outage status or root cause from the limited information provided.
Acknowledge urgency and escalation without promising a specific fix time or refund.
